correctness.rationale: Direct elimination from the actual RESULT.md recurrence gives y^{k+1}=bz^{k+1}; on the invariant manifold rho r=b Delta z and |s|=rho|Delta z|, hence |r|/|s|=b/rho^2 on nonstationary steps. The resulting three-branch map enters [sqrt(b/mu),sqrt(mu b)] for every positive start iff tau<=mu; for tau>mu every rho in (sqrt(mu b)/tau,sqrt(b/mu)) is a literal two-cycle. Substitution gives q(rho)=(rho^2+ab)/((a+rho)(b+rho)) in (0,1), and differentiation gives the unique fixed-penalty minimizer sqrt(ab). The packaged exact-rational checker is consistent with, but not a substitute for, these analytic steps.
risks: The residual ratio is undefined at the stationary zero-residual state, where the usual rule simply leaves rho unchanged.
